title: Single-Database Rewards Are Hackable: Counterfactual Execution for Trustworthy Text-to-SQL RL
abstract: arXiv:2611.34363v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for text-to-SQL agents pays a query when its result matches the reference on one database. However, a wrong query can match by luck when the data lack the rows that expose its bug. We study a counterfactual-database (CF) reward that also runs the final query on a few hidden, code-generated copies of the database and pays only if all results match (strict form) or by the share matched (mean form). On 1,302 synthetic audit questions, the strict form lowers the share of buggy queries paid in full from 29.5% to 16.8% and of reward hacks from 54.1% to 1.9%, rejecting 0 of 2,847 correct queries; copies from a family-blind generator do about as well. In a controlled GRPO comparison on a 3.35B model with three seeds per arm, training on the mean form did not improve in-domain accuracy (8.4% vs 11.7%), because the two rewards disagreed on only 5-7% of rollouts; on Spider it gained 1.6 points. translated_title: 单一数据库奖励可被破解：用于可信赖文本到SQL强化学习的反事实执行
translated_abstract: 面向文本到SQL智能体的强化学习（RL）通常在查询结果与单一数据库上的参考结果匹配时给予奖励。然而，当数据缺乏能够暴露查询缺陷的行时，错误的查询可能凭运气匹配成功。我们研究了一种反事实数据库（CF）奖励，它还在若干隐藏的、由代码生成的数据库副本上运行最终查询，仅在所有结果都匹配时（严格形式）或按匹配比例（平均形式）给予奖励。在1,302个合成审计问题上，严格形式将错误查询被全额支付的比例从29.5%降至16.8%，将奖励破解的比例从54.1%降至1.9%，同时拒绝了2,847个正确查询中的0个；来自“模型家族盲”生成器生成的副本表现大致相当。在一个3.35B模型上的受控GRPO对比实验（每组三个随机种子）中，使用平均形式训练并未提升域内准确率（8.4% vs 11.7%），因为两种奖励仅在5-7%的rollout上存在分歧；而在Spider上提升了1.6个点。（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种反事实数据库奖励机制，通过在隐藏的代码生成数据库副本上执行查询来验证结果，将文本到SQL强化学习中的奖励破解率从54.1%大幅降至1.9%，且不误拒任何正确查询。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a counterfactual-database reward that executes final queries on hidden code-generated database copies, reducing reward hacking in text-to-SQL RL from 54.1% to 1.9% while rejecting zero correct queries.
